report_title: AURA Studio UX & Genuine Garment Cutout Acceptance Report
final_decision_rationale: Studio interaction was completely redesigned from three stacked inventory database rows into a focused Wardrobe Styling Canvas. The Current Look (EditorialOutfitCanvas) is the singular visual hero. Tapping any piece (or selecting Top, Bottom, Shoes, Outerwear) makes that specific slot active with subtle highlight, and the user swipes through garments for that slot via CurrentPieceBrowser, updating the outfit composition and qualitative AURA styling intelligence instantaneously. Furthermore, all lifestyle photographs (humans, faces, limbs, rooms, pedestals) have been audited and replaced with genuine, transparent RGBA PNG single garment cutouts (alpha extrema: 0 to 255). Phone connection and bundling (3165 modules) on physical iPhone was verified with fluid touch response, scroll-locked crop gestures, zero ML training, zero model weight changes, zero commercial APIs, and strict preservation of the blind holdout checksum (5371dfe1d0911aa80a1570b0a54ba198a250770311389de707d9cf0c799d43bd).

hierarchy: 1. Studio Header: Context pill + Title + Feedback actions (ThumbsDown / Heart)
2. Studio Mode Switcher: BUILD vs AURA tabs
3. Look Meta: Composition name / candidate archetype
4. CURRENT LOOK (Visual Hero): EditorialOutfitCanvas (flat-lay with active slot highlight)
5. AURA INSIGHT: Live Style & Colour Intelligence box (WHY THIS WORKS, soft contrast, neutral anchor)
6. Action Pair: [ Save Look ] (primary black) + [ Try It On ] (outline)
7. CURRENT PIECE BROWSING CONTROL: CurrentPieceBrowser (Category tabs + Stepper controls + Horizontal swipe carousel)

lifestyle_image_handling.policy: Lifestyle photographs of humans wearing clothing are NEVER directly rendered as wardrobe assets. They undergo automatic background removal with rembg/u2net and non-garment elimination, or prompt manual region selection.
lifestyle_image_handling.database_seed_fix: INITIAL_SEED_GARMENTS updated from raw Unsplash URLs to SEED_GARMENT_CUTOUTS base64 transparent PNGs in src/services/database/seedData.ts.

manual_fallback.controls: 52x52 touch handles, 5% padding guard, parent ScrollView scroll-lock prevents page scrolling while dragging.

screens_compared.comparison: Clean flat-lay canvas with generous neutral whitespace, refined Platypi/Lora typography, subtle pill tags, no neon AI effects, no dark SaaS dashboard.
Complete look curation with LOOK 01 / LOOK 02 candidate selection cards.
Clean grid of genuinely isolated clothing items on subtle card surfaces.
Import flow leading to clean single garment cutout with [ TRY IT ON ] and [ ADD TO CLOSET ].
